content: If someone has overdosed and is experiencing severe symptoms such as loss of consciousness or difficulty breathing, immediately call emergency services (911). For other cases, contact a poison control center without delay. Residents in the United States can call 1-800-222-1222, while those in Canada can call 1-844-764-7669. This medication has been prescribed specifically for your current condition. It is important to undergo any recommended laboratory or medical tests, such as a complete blood count or kidney function tests, while using this medication. If you miss a dose of this medication, it is crucial to contact your doctor or pharmacist promptly to establish a new dosing schedule. Do not attempt to make up for the missed dose without professional guidance. For proper storage of this medication, refer to the product instructions or consult your pharmacist. Do not dispose of medications by flushing them down the toilet or pouring them into a drain unless explicitly instructed to do so. When the medication is expired or no longer needed, dispose of it properly according to local guidelines. The information provided here is a summary and does not include all possible details about this product. It does not guarantee that the product is safe, effective, or suitable for your specific needs. This information is not a substitute for personalized medical advice. Always consult your healthcare professional for complete information about this medication and your individual health requirements.
